Multitag (all-in-one)

A
Written by Admin
February 3, 2026

Our Multitag made the monetization process much easier. With just one click, publishers can create four tags with different ad formats.

All you need to do is grab a new ad code, insert one ad tag into your website's source code, and you’re ready to go.

MultiTag consists of 4 ad formats:

- Onclick

- Push Notifications

- In-Page Push

- Vignette Banner

All these ad formats work perfectly together, giving you another opportunity to generate the highest possible revenue while still ensuring a great user experience.

This is how the process of getting the tag will look in the personal account:

  1. Choose the MultiTag zone inside your Monetag dashboard after you have added the website:
    ​

2. After creating the tag you will see the window with the common information about your new Multitag. Name the tag (you can use the default name or create your own).
​


3. Copy the code and insert it into your site’s source code (below the <head> tag). You should also download a sw.js file from the Monetag platform for correct work if you're using HTTPS.


4. All four ad formats will become available for your website.

Please note that these zones will have different IDs but one name, and all will be marked with a ‘MULTI’ property sign.


​If you have any questions, feel free to contact our support team via support@monetag.com
